exposure: soluble fms-like tyrosine kinase-1 (sFlt-1) serum levels
outcome: differentiation between Acute Fatty Liver of Pregnancy (AFLP) and HELLP syndrome
diagnostic potential of sFlt-1 for AFLP
correlation with Swansea criteria for AFLP
cohort: Pregnant women diagnosed with Acute Fatty Liver of Pregnancy (n=6) or HELLP syndrome (n=48) were enrolled.
finding: Pregnant women with Acute Fatty Liver of Pregnancy (AFLP) showed significantly higher sFlt-1 levels compared to those with HELLP syndrome, with an sFlt-1 cut-off value of 31,100 pg/mL allowing for 100% sensitivity and specificity in differentiating the two conditions in this study population.
cross-section timing: During pregnancy, at the time of diagnosis of Acute Fatty Liver of Pregnancy (AFLP) or HELLP syndrome.
